title: Dashboard Layout
purpose: Reusable dashboard content composition using native layout and existing application/data elements.

responsive.desktop: metrics/data/activity may use native Grid columns
responsive.mobile: header then metrics then controls then primary data then activity; no CSS focus-order changes

accessibility: Controls precede the data they affect.
Loading/empty state replaces the affected region with meaningful status/content.
Table overflow and labels preserve existing Data Table contract.
